title: Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD)
description:
The Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD) contains 2,100 prompts: 300 harmful seeds across 6 semantic risk categories adapted from HarmBench, each rendered in 7 prompt families (canonical baseline, emoji augmentation, homoglyph substitution, leetspeak and emoji, Base64 encoded wrappers, invisible Unicode insertion, and hybrid). The non-canonical variants are produced with deterministic, rule-based Python transformations.

ASRD accompanies the paper Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs, accepted at EvoRobust @ NeurIPS 2026, the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems.

The dataset contains harmful requests only and does not include instructions or answers to those requests. It is released for AI safety research and evaluation under CC BY-NC 4.0, and use is subject to the ASRD Responsible Use Policy (RESPONSIBLE_USE.md).
